description: Azelastine may decrease the diuretic activities of Torasemide.
The therapeutic efficacy of Torasemide can be decreased when used in combination with Azelastine.
Azelastine may increase the QTc-prolonging activities of Torasemide.
The risk or severity of QTc prolongation can be increased when Azelastine is combined with Torasemide.
The metabolism of Torasemide can be decreased when combined with Azelastine.
